_doc: Automations: when an event happens, run actions. automations.py's docstring has everything;
`automations.py catalog` lists the events and actions, `automations.py check` validates this file.
A rule: {id, name, enabled, when: {event, ...options}, do: [{action, value}], cooldown (s, default 10)}.
Keys starting with _ are ignored. Settings > Automations edits this file too.

Events (options): app-open (class), app-close (class), game-start, game-end, monitor-added (name), monitor-removed (name), audio-output (device), wifi-connected (ssid), wifi-disconnected (ssid), dnd-on, dnd-off, idle-start, idle-end, presence-away, presence-back, time (at, days), work-start, work-end, phone-connected, phone-disconnected, context-enter (name), context-leave (name), focus-start, focus-end.

Actions (value): theme NAME, dnd on|off, gamemode on|off, sound-output TEXT, sound-profile "CARD PROFILE", nightlight on|off|auto, notify TEXT, shell TEXT, open TEXT, session NAME, context NAME, digest, brief, journal, task NAME, focus TEXT.
